clue.text: Capital in which the law is broken

indicators.note: something broken is smashed into pieces, so the letters of the phrase before it are put back together differently

explanation.surface: A country or city where lawlessness reigns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like a city, setting the theme of the puzzle, but here it means money.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital in the financial sense is accumulated money or assets, a synonym for riches.

clue.text: Undoing wrong, so to speak, in second of three capitals of Russia

definitions.text: second of three capitals of Russia

indicators.note: a phrase meaning 'as one might say out loud', so the word must be heard rather than seen

parts.note: putting a wrong right is righting it

explanation.surface: Correcting an injustice in St Petersburg, once the second of Russia's capitals.
explanation.walkthrough: The three capitals of 'Russia' are its three capital Rs, standing for the three Rs of schooling: reading, writing and arithmetic. The second of these is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The three Rs are the basic school skills, reading, penmanship and arithmetic; the second is putting words on paper.

clue.text: A couple of cents artist accumulated as capital

parts.note: c is the abbreviation for cent, and two of them make two Cs
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword stock artist

explanation.surface: A painter saving a few pennies until they add up to some money.
explanation.definitionFit: Accra is the capital city of Ghana, in West Africa.

clue.text: Raising a bit of cash ahead of the game

definitions.text: Raising a bit of cash ahead of the game

parts.words: Raising a bit of cash ahead of the game
parts.note: sounds like fundraising before a match, but describes flipping a coin into the air before kick-off to decide ends

explanation.surface: Collecting money before a sporting fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raising' suggests fundraising; it is literally lifting a coin in the air for the toss that starts many games.
explanation.definitionFit: Flipping a coin up to decide who starts is the ritual that opens a cricket or football match.

clue.text: President briefly in capital of Wyoming

definitions.text: President briefly in capital of Wyoming

parts.words: President briefly in capital of Wyoming
parts.note: the full name of a US president with his middle initial dropped; put the capital letter of Wyoming, W, inside it and the son's name appears

explanation.surface: A head of state making a short visit to Cheyenne.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital of Wyoming' suggests Cheyenne but is the letter W: the answer with W inserted names the younger president, so the answer itself is a shortened presidential name.
explanation.definitionFit: Two American presidents, father and son, share this first name and surname, the son adding the initial W.

clue.text: Bishop has to dismiss rising resistance to church

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the word is read from the bottom upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to axe someone is to sack or dismiss them
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A bishop is obliged to sack an increasingly rebellious opponent of the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns AXE into EXA, read up the down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An exarch is a bishop ranking above a metropolitan in the Eastern Orthodox churches.

clue.text: Person with painful illness — cure him at resort

indicators.note: read as re-sort, to sort again, so the letters before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone in pain is told to go to a spa town for treatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a spa or holiday town but is RE-SORT, rearranging CURE HIM AT.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone rheumatic suffers from rheumatism, a painful condition of the joints and muscles.

clue.text: East Russian girl getting over time in part of former USSR

indicators.note: a piece that gets over something in a down clue sits on top of it, here around it, so it encloses the next letter

parts.note: Sonia is a familiar Russian girl's name

explanation.surface: An eastern Russian woman recovering from a period in the Soviet Union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting over' is not recovery but SONIA spanning T, giving STONIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonia was one of the Baltic republics of the Soviet Union until 1991.

clue.text: Lasting effect of injury a hindrance to athlete or climber

parts.note: a wound often leaves a permanent mark, a scar
a let is an old word for an obstacle, as in 'without let or hindrance'
a runner is a track athlete

explanation.surface: A permanent injury that holds back a sprinter or a mountaineer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climber' seems to be a mountaineer but is a climbing plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarlet runner is a climbing bean plant with red flowers, grown up poles in gardens.

clue.text: Record is set in area of American capital

indicators.note: something set in another is placed inside it

parts.note: DC, the District of Columbia, is the area holding Washington

explanation.surface: A record is established in Washington.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc is a gramophone record or other recording medium.

clue.text: Eg marriage with love in state capital

parts.note: matrimony is one of the Christian sacraments, so marriage is an example of one
love is nil, zero, in tennis scoring, hence O

explanation.surface: A wedding taking place romantically in a state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacramento is the capital city of the US state of California.

clue.text: King and I entertaining one girl in African capital

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king in chess and cards

indicators.note: one who entertains a guest holds them within, so the letters round the next piece enclose it

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
gal is an informal word for a girl

explanation.surface: A monarch and the speaker hosting a young woman in an African city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'King and I' recalls the musical, but gives K and I, with I (one) after: the two Is wrap GAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Kigali is the capital city of Rwanda, in central Africa.

clue.text: Wealthy Scotsman died, providing capital for state

parts.note: wealthy means rich
mon is the Scots form of man, so a crossword Scotsman
d is the abbreviation for died in records and genealogies

explanation.surface: A rich Scot's death leaves money to fund a state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' again looks like money in the will, but means a state's seat of government.
explanation.definitionFit: Richmond is the capital city of the US state of Virginia.

clue.text: Novel way to create energy with gas

indicators.note: a recipe for making something, read as an instruction to build a new arrangement from the letters

explanation.surface: An inventive method of making power from gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like an adjective for the method, but is the book.
explanation.definitionFit: Agnes Grey is the first novel by Anne Bronte, published in 1847.

clue.text: European in next cell tortured in capital

indicators.note: the letter for European is placed inside the rearranged letters
tortured means twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A European is being tortured in the next prison cell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tortured' rearranges NEXT CELL to XCLLENT-style letters, with E placed among them; 'capital' is the old adjective, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital as an old-fashioned adjective means first-rate, splendid, the same as superb.

clue.text: Greek's walk from Piraeus to Athens

indicators.note: the letters are taken from inside the words that follow, straddling them

explanation.surface: A Greek walking route from the port of Piraeus up to Athens.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across PiraeuS TO Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: A stoa is a covered colonnade or portico in ancient Greece, used as a public walkway.

clue.text: Walk in capital after parking

indicators.note: the word for capital comes after the parking abbreviation

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs
ace and capital both mean excellent

explanation.surface: Strolling around a city after leaving the car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' here is the adjective meaning first-rate, not a city.
explanation.definitionFit: To pace is to walk with measured steps, as when pacing up and down.

clue.text: Expert is restricted by very old condition

parts.note: a pro, or professional, is an expert

indicators.note: a piece restricted by others is hemmed in by them, so it sits inside

parts.note: V is very and O is old, both standard abbreviations

explanation.surface: A specialist is limited by a long-standing stipulation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restricted' suggests a limited specialist, but the phrase 'is restricted by' is a container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A proviso is a condition or stipulation attached to an agreement.

clue.text: Protective garment a cottager fashioned

indicators.note: fashioned means made or shaped, so the letters are made into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A villager has stitched together a sturdy coat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fashioned' hints at clothes-making, apt for a coat, but it rearranges A COTTAGER.
explanation.definitionFit: A greatcoat is a heavy overcoat that protects against cold, especially a military one.

clue.text: Attending worker in one US city or another

parts.note: at means present at, attending

indicators.note: the insect worker sits inside the abbreviation for the city

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, is a US city
the ant is the stock crossword worker

explanation.surface: Someone works in one American city or another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the definition: a second US city beside LA.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlanta is a major US city, the capital of Georgia, so it stands as yet another American city.

clue.text: City in Georgia, state capital (not 18)

definitions.meaning: a city in the US state of Georgia, on the Savannah river
the capital of Maine, a state capital but not Georgia's, which is the answer to 18

explanation.surface: A Georgian city that is a state capital, but not of its own state.
explanation.walkthrough: The same name serves a city in Georgia and the capital of Maine; 18 (Atlanta) is Georgia's real capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Augusta is a city in Georgia famous for the Masters golf tournament, and also the capital of Maine.

clue.text: Capital invested by Germans in second boat

parts.note: mo is an informal word for a moment, a second
a scow is a flat-bottomed boat

explanation.surface: German money put into a second vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'invested' looks like finance but means besieged: German forces laid siege to the city in 1941.
explanation.definitionFit: Moscow, the Russian capital, was besieged by German armies in the winter of 1941.

clue.text: Admirable and fine hair, but keep your shirt on!

parts.note: cool is slang for admirable or impressive
down is soft fine hair or feathers

explanation.surface: Someone praising a lovely head of hair while telling another to calm down.
explanation.definitionFit: Keep your shirt on is an idiom urging someone not to lose their temper, to calm themselves.

clue.text: Sudden thrust across ring — take it easy!

indicators.note: the thrust goes across the ring, so it encloses it

parts.note: a lunge is a sudden forward thrust, as in fencing
the letter O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A boxer makes a sudden lunge across the ring, but is told to relax.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' suggests boxing but is just the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: To lounge is to recline lazily, an idiomatic way to take it easy.

clue.text: Shaded area in part of Italy — not its capital

indicators.note: the letter I is always written as a capital, so the capital to remove is that letter

parts.note: Umbria is a region of central Italy

explanation.surface: A shady district in an Italian region, but not its main city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'its capital' looks like Perugia, Umbria's chief city, but is the letter I, always a capital letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The umbra is the fully shaded inner part of a shadow, as in an eclipse.

clue.text: Like a relatively long film show

definitions.text: Like a relatively long film show

parts.words: Like a relatively long film show
parts.note: sounds like a film of great running time, but means a projection format that is long from side to side

explanation.surface: A description of a lengthy cinema programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long' suggests duration; the format is long horizontally, relative to its height.
explanation.definitionFit: A widescreen picture has a large width-to-height ratio, so it is long horizontally compared with standard.

clue.text: See 4
A measure of power, with zero backing, in capital

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the whole run is read in reverse

parts.note: the watt is the unit of electrical power
the letter O resembles zero

explanation.surface: Zero support for a measure of power in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reverses A WATT O to read OTTAWA.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottawa is the capital city of Canada.

clue.text: A vehicle parking in hospital area of capital city

indicators.note: a van parking in a place sits inside it, so these letters go inside the others

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital on road signs
a van is a road vehicle

explanation.surface: A van parked in the hospital zone of a city.
explanation.walkthrough: A VAN sits between H and A.
explanation.definitionFit: Havana is the capital city of Cuba.
